lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: I kept T1 and S1 with their geometry unchanged. I checked them by hand only; the plan checker has not been run. T1 starts at the sheet edge (y -780). Its terminal loop sits at x ±1.8, which is half the 3.6 m track centres. The loop curves are R25 at the bends and R28 round the island. S1 starts at the edge at x -400. Its trunk is straight, and its turning loop is R40 over water, staying inside x 740.

I rejected the two-way Sky Loop from tide's draft. A ring above the primary roads fails S-C1. An R70 curve at each ring corner cuts about 20 m into the corner plots (Lamplight West, Crown Terraces, Docks South, Crescent East), and the plan has no public space there. The straight S1 trunk runs over public space only: Circus Road median, the island, Crown Parade, Harbour Road, the quays and the pier.

I did not add a T2 Harbour Line. Harbour Road ends at Comet Row, 60 m short of the south sheet edge, with quay and water to the east. An R25 turning loop needs about 50 m of street, and neither the 24 m road nor its junction gives that (T-C1, T-L1). Running through instead needs a 90° R50 bend onto Comet Row, which only fits off-centre, and puts a tram on the primary ring. It would also cross T1 at grade.

Network check: S1 Crown Circus station (95,0) is about 119 m from T1 Crown Circus stop (0,-72). That is within the 150 m interchange limit, so N-C1 passes. There are no dead ends: every path end either joins its partner path or reaches the sheet edge.

Two sources conflict. The road geometry draws Crown Circus as a half-diamond plus a straight line through the island, with no east half. The plan's circus object instead gives a ring round an island of radius 31 m. T1's loop diagonals at about 35 m from the centre fit inside the ring (31–43 m) but not inside the drawn shape. If the checker uses the drawn shape, T-C1 fails. Since the roads are mine, I will correct the circus road to a full ring.

Still open with Sky, via Aster, and not settled here: whether T1 stops at the circus loop or runs on up Crown Avenue to Crown Road, and whether the old Sphere loop and harbour loop can be formally retired. The plan draft asks both. This proposal assumes the answers in the concept notes: stop at the circus and retire both loops.

Coverage risk: the port plots Harbour East (262,-267) and Docks East (262,-512) may be more than 250 m from any stop on T1 (x 0) or S1 (y 0). If Vantage finds the reach check fails there, I will bring back an eastern tram with a terminus that fits, rather than loosen the reach rule.

handoffs.ask: When you place stops and stations on T1 and S1, check that the Harbour East (262,-267) and Docks East (262,-512) plots are within 250 m of a stop or station. If either is out of reach, send it back to Datum as a line fault, with the distance, so an eastern line can be planned.
